caption: The drawing depicts a cylindrical container with a slightly open, dome-shaped lid. The lid is illustrated leaning against the container, partially detached and showing the interior. Both the container and the lid feature intricate geometric patterns. The container’s body is decorated with a repeating chevron (zigzag) pattern in shades of blue, red, black, and tan against a light background, with dark horizontal bands at the top and bottom edges. The lid is adorned with a star-like, symmetrical motif in the center, surrounded by triangular segments filled with lines and colored areas in blue, tan, black, and reddish-brown. The drawing is rendered on a beige background, with the image framed by a simple outline. There are some faint stains and discolorations visible on the surrounding paper.
title: Box
